description: Maps every factual script claim to its evidence. Mission section 7's explicit requirement: unverified factual claims may not silently enter the final script -- enforced downstream by script.py::fact_check_script(), which removes any claim whose ledger entry is not VERIFIED/PARTIAL.

fields.claim_id: matches an EvidenceItem.evidence_id, or is REJECTED if the script referenced a claim_id with no matching evidence item (this is itself a finding, never silently dropped)
fields.script_segment: the ScriptSegment.segment_id this claim appears in
fields.verification_status: VERIFIED | PARTIAL | UNVERIFIED | OPINION | HYPOTHESIS | REJECTED
fields.uncertainty: string or null, carried from the source EvidenceItem
fields.editorial_transform_status: UNCHANGED_FROM_EVIDENCE | REWORDED -- REWORDED only when the spoken text differs from the source claim_text after leading-tag stripping

verification_status_rule: VERIFIED if the source EvidenceItem's claim_class is FACT or ANALYSIS; PARTIAL otherwise (INTERPRETATION/HYPOTHESIS/UNVERIFIED); REJECTED if no matching evidence item exists at all.
